name: kensa-qa
description: ISTQB CTFL v4.0.1-grounded manual QA team for the Kensa TMS — Codex edition. Ships 33 skills (20 ISTQB-grounded + 13 tooling, incl. browser-driven QA, schema adaptation, and Blueprints automation) and a cross-platform Stop hook for auto memory checkpoints. Test Lead + QA Engineer + Strategist install as project-scoped Codex subagents (.codex/agents/*.toml).

interface.shortDescription: ISTQB-grounded manual QA team in your pocket
interface.longDescription: A coordinated manual-QA team for the Kensa test-management system. A Test Lead plans coverage and reviews; QA Engineers author checklists and test cases grounded in the ISTQB CTFL v4.0.1 syllabus. Ships 33 skills, a cross-platform Stop hook, read-only SDLC analysis prompts (spec review, risk, test plan, traceability), schema adaptation, and Blueprints node-graph automation.
